cells.D9:
Performs an evasive maneuver that reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

cells.C251:
Reload Perk Notes:

Generate = Grants Ammo to Magazine out of thin air, up to its Base Magazine Size. Does not work with Overflown Magazines.

Overflow = Increases Base Magazine Capacity by a certain amount, rounded up.

Refill = Reload, but does not have an animation and doesn't proc on-reload perks. Pulls from reserves on Special and Power Weapons.
For Heat Weapons, it will instead be "Dissipates X Heat" to discern it from manual venting

Reload = Procs on-reload perks. Manual Reload, Marksman's Dodge, and Dragon's Shadow all count as regular reloads.
For Heat Weapons, finishing a manual vent will count as a regular reload.

implementation.scope: Reload branch only; not a complete dodge ability.
implementation.energy: One-charge account, base rate 1/42; no Class stat modifiers yet. Identity gain path represents CES 1.
implementation.reload: Equipped declared weapons at the scheduled reload moment; physically verified then atomically transferred.
implementation.timing: calibration.reload_delay is required and snapshotted before payment. Test-only 0.2 seconds is not original-game timing.
implementation.zero_transfer: transferred policy is an explicit assumption; full magazine or zero reserves do not qualify without actual transfer.
implementation.lifetime: Accepted reload is detached from later ability deselection; recipient liveness and physical equipment still checked at execution. This is a Chorus content policy, not original-game calibration.

limits: Dodge motion, animation, 15m ammo-brick pickup, combatant projectile tracking removal and Guardian aim-assist removal are not implemented.
Class stat recharge/gain curves, enhanced Class overshield, exotic interactions, subclass restrictions, input/HUD and production selection assembly remain incomplete.
Reload timing, equipment sampling, deselection/cancellation and zero-transfer perk qualification need original-game validation.
Test weapons, capacities and reload healing observers are synthetic; weapon ammunition is not yet persisted across runtimes.
The original Weapon Perks HTML was reused from the earlier same-day Dual Loader capture; Class Abilities was fetched for this review.
